cards.prose: Matthew has the scribes and Pharisees ask for a sign and answers *An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign*; Luke has the answer go out to a crowd *gathered thick together*. Luke goes on at once to say what Jonah was, *a sign unto the Ninevites* (Luke 11:30), and puts the weight on the preaching Nineveh repented at. Matthew's next verse adds the three days and three nights.
cards.member_phrase: there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonah
cards.member_sentence: Matthew gives the same answer to the scribes and Pharisees who asked for a sign, and calls the generation adulterous as well as evil.

cards.prose: In Luke a woman in the crowd blesses the womb that bore him, and he answers *Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of Elohim (God), and keep it* (Luke 11:28). Matthew has his mother and brothers waiting outside and the same turn: the ones he names as *brother, and sister, and mother* are those who do the Father's will. The family is known by the hearing that keeps the word.
cards.member_sentence: Matthew gives the same answer in his own words, naming as his brother and sister and mother whoever does the will of his Father in heaven.
